Rafael Nadal vs Jannik Sinner - Quarterfinals Highlights | Roland-Garros 2020. Watch the best moments from the match that opposed Rafael Nadal and Jannik Sinner at the quarterfinals of 2020! Rafael Nadal won 7/6 6/4 6/1.
